entry.title: New: Resolution 372 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES: (1) THE HIRING OF SCHLACK ITO, A LIMITED LIABILITY LAW COMPANY, AS SPECIAL COUNSEL TO REPRESENT THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I IN HUI MALĀMA HONOKŌHAU V. COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I, CIVIL NO. 1:23-CV-00393; AND (2) THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT WITH SPECIAL COUNSEL FOR THE COUNTY’S LEGAL DEFENSE IN HUI MALĀMA HONOKŌHAU V. COUNTY O

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a multi-year agreement with Schlack Ito to provide legal services, with expenses not to exceed $200,000.
